start.text:
An ancient prophecy speaks of the Arch-Lich Vorn, sealed away a thousand years ago. Now, an eclipse approaches — and with it, a surge of necromantic energy that will free Vorn unless his phylactery is destroyed.

The Archmage Council has sent you to Vorn's Obsidian Fortress — a hovering citadel above the Shattered Wastes. Its wards are weakening. You must infiltrate, find the phylactery, and shatter it before the eclipse.

Your skyship circles the fortress. Three entry points are visible: a crumbling balcony, a sewer grate, and the main gate flanked by undead sentinels.

choices.text: Land on the crumbling balcony — stealth approach
Enter through the sewer grate below
Circle once more to scout for weaknesses

scout_success.text:
Your keen eyes spot a pattern — the undead sentinels rotate on a fixed schedule. There's a 30-second gap at the main gate every five minutes. You also notice the balcony leads to what appears to be an old library.

The sewer grate connects to an underground reservoir — likely unguarded but potentially flooded.

choices.text: Use the gate rotation gap to slip inside

scout_fail.text: The fortress's dark aura makes your eyes water. You can't make out much more than the three entry points.

balcony.text:
You leap from the skyship onto the crumbling balcony. Stone cracks underfoot but holds. Inside, a vast library — shelves of forbidden tomes, some still glowing with arcane energy.

A spectral librarian floats between shelves, cataloguing endlessly. It hasn't noticed you yet.

choices.text: Search the library for information about the phylactery
Destroy the specter with holy magic

library_clear.text: You pass the specter unseen and find a door leading deeper into the fortress. A corridor stretches ahead — left toward sounds of clanking chains, right toward an ominous green glow.

choices.text: Go right toward the green glow

phylactery_location.text: A dusty tome reveals crucial information: 'The Phylactery of Vorn rests in the Sanctum of Binding, the fortress's deepest chamber, protected by three wards: the Ward of Bone, the Ward of Shadow, and the Ward of Soul. Each must be broken before the Sanctum can be entered.'

choices.text: Head deeper to find the wards

specter_fight.text: The spectral librarian shrieks and attacks! Its ghostly touch chills your blood. You fight back and disperse it, but the commotion may have alerted others.

choices.text: Move deeper into the fortress quickly

sewer.text:
The sewer is vile — stagnant water, the stench of death. You wade through thigh-deep muck. Bones float in the water — not just animals.

A low growl echoes ahead. Something lives down here.

sewer_clear.text: You emerge into the fortress's sublevel — old dungeons and storage. Stairs lead up to the main corridors.

sewer_attack.text: A ghoul erupts from the water! Its paralyzing claws scrape your armor. You fight it off but the encounter drains you.

gate_breach.text: You smash through the undead sentinels and force your way inside. The great hall is a cathedral of darkness — obsidian pillars, a floor of skulls, and a throne of bone at the far end. Empty, for now.

gate_repelled.text: The undead sentinels overwhelm you! You're forced back, bloody and battered. You'll need another way in.

prison_wing.text:
The prison wing holds ancient cells — most empty. But in one, a figure stirs: an old wizard, emaciated, chained with anti-magic shackles.

'You... you're alive? Living? I'm Erasmus. Vorn captured me decades ago for my knowledge of ward-breaking. I can help you — if you free me.'

choices.text: Leave him — could be a trap

erasmus_ally.text: The shackles break! Erasmus stretches, and weak arcane light flickers around his fingers. 'My power returns. Give me time to recover and I'll help you break the wards. I know where all three are.'

erasmus_slow.text: The shackles are tough — you break them but it takes time. Erasmus is free but weak.

ritual_chamber.text: The ritual chamber glows with sickly green light. Necromantic circles are etched into the floor. A massive ward-stone — the Ward of Bone — pulses at the center, radiating dark energy. Skeletal warriors guard it.

choices.text: Fight the skeletons and destroy the ward!
Try to disable the ward with magic/knowledge

ward_bone.text:
Erasmus leads you to the Ward of Bone — a massive pillar of fused skeletons radiating dark energy. His knowledge helps immensely.

'There — the keystone at the center. Shatter it and the ward falls. But the guardians won't let you.'

ward_bone_broken.text:
The Ward of Bone shatters! Bone fragments scatter as the dark energy dissipates. One ward down, two to go. The fortress shudders — Vorn's power weakens.

The eclipse is closer. The sky outside darkens.

ward_bone_hurt.text: The skeletal guardians are fierce. You finally break through and destroy the ward, but take heavy damage.

choices.text: Push on to the Ward of Shadow

ward_shadow.text: The Ward of Shadow is in the fortress's heart — a room of impenetrable darkness. Shadows coalesce into wraith-like forms. The ward-stone is invisible in the dark; you must find it by other means.

choices.text: Light a radiant torch to burn away the shadows
Navigate by sound — the ward-stone hums

ward_shadow_broken.text:
The Ward of Shadow explodes in a burst of blinding light as you shatter the ward-stone! Shadows scream and dissolve. The room returns to normal — stone walls, torches reigniting.

Two wards down. One to go.

choices.text: Find the final ward — the Ward of Soul

shadow_overwhelm.text: The shadows are overwhelming — their cold drains your life force. But desperation empowers you. With a final, brutal blow, you find and shatter the ward-stone.

ward_soul.text:
The Ward of Soul is the cruelest — it's powered by trapped souls, visible as screaming faces in a crystal sphere. Destroying it will free them, but the sphere fights back, assaulting your mind with their agony.

A voice echoes: Vorn's voice. 'Foolish mortal. Turn back. My power is ETERNAL.'

choices.text: Steel your mind and shatter the sphere!
Channel positive energy to free the souls gently

ward_soul_broken.text:
The crystal shatters! Freed souls stream upward through the fortress, their grateful whispers filling the air. The Ward of Soul is broken.

All three wards are down. The Sanctum of Binding is open.

The eclipse begins — a dark shadow eating the sun. Time is running out.

choices.text: Enter the Sanctum and face the phylactery!

soul_struggle.text: The soul trap's psychic assault nearly breaks you. You scream as memories and emotions that aren't yours flood your mind. But you shatter the crystal.

sanctum.text:
The Sanctum of Binding: a vast circular chamber of obsidian black. In its center, floating above an altar, a crystalline orb pulses with deathly green light — Vorn's Phylactery.

As you step forward, the air freezes. Vorn's spirit manifests — a towering specter of bones and dark robes, crown of iron on his skull, eyes burning with malice.

'You cannot destroy what is eternal,' he hisses. 'I have waited a thousand years. The eclipse feeds my power. And YOU... will be my first servant in the new age.'

choices.text: Strike the phylactery with everything you have!
Resist Vorn's magic and push through to the altar!
Use the knowledge from the library to exploit a weakness

vorn_blast.text: Vorn's necrotic blast slams into you like a wall of ice and death. Your body screams. But you won't stop. Not now. With blood streaming from your nose, you reach the altar.

choices.text: Bring your weapon down on the phylactery!

phylactery_cracked.text:
Your blow strikes the phylactery! A web of cracks spreads across its surface. Vorn SCREAMS — a sound that shakes the entire fortress.

'NO! I AM ETERNAL! I AM—'

You strike again. And again. The phylactery SHATTERS.

Blinding white light erupts from the fragments. Vorn's spirit is ripped apart, his essence dissolving into nothing. The green fire in his eyes goes dark forever.

The obsidian fortress groans and begins to fall. Without Vorn's power sustaining it, the citadel is collapsing from the sky.

choices.text: Run for the skyship! The fortress is falling!

close_call.text: Corridors collapse around you. Rubble falls. You're hit but keep running. The skyship is ahead — you leap as the floor crumbles beneath you and catch the ladder.

choices.text: The skyship carries you to safety

victory.text:
The Obsidian Fortress plummets from the sky and shatters on the Wastes below, raising a cloud of dark dust. The eclipse passes. Sunlight returns, golden and warm.

Vorn is destroyed. Forever. No phylactery to anchor his spirit, no fortress to house his power. The Arch-Lich's millennium of terror is truly over.

The Archmage Council hails you as the greatest hero of the age. Songs are written, statues erected. You receive a legendary artifact from the Council's vault — an item of immense power, a reward worthy of the one who slew the undying.

But more than treasure, you carry something priceless: the knowledge that the world's greatest evil is gone, and it was your hand that ended it.

The phylactery's call is silenced. Forever.
